# pve_node_capabilities (Data Source)

QEMU capabilities of a node: CPU models, CPU flags, machine types, and migration limits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_node_capabilities" "example" {
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `accel` (String) Acceleration type to check node compatibility for. (default: kvm) One of: `kvm`, `tcg`.
- `arch` (String) Virtual processor architecture. Defaults to the host architecture. One of: `x86_64`, `aarch64`.

### Read-Only

- `capabilities` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node}/capabilities (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `cpu_flags` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/capabilities/qemu/cpu-flags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cpu_flags))
- `cpu_models` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/capabilities/qemu/cpu. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cpu_models))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `machines` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/capabilities/qemu/machines. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines))
- `migration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--migration))
- `qemu` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node}/capabilities/qemu (the API schema does not describe its shape).

<a id="nestedatt--cpu_flags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cpu_flags`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the CPU flag.
- `name` (String) Name of the CPU flag.
- `supported_on` (List of String) List of nodes supporting the CPU flag with the selected acceleration type ("accel").


<a id="nestedatt--cpu_models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cpu_models`

Read-Only:

- `abstract` (Boolean) True for PVE-internal abstract profiles like x86-64-v2, -v3, -v4. These do not correspond to a QEMU CPU type and cannot be used as a custom model's 'reported-model'.
- `custom` (Boolean) True if this is a custom CPU model.
- `name` (String) Name of the CPU model. Identifies it for subsequent API calls. Prefixed with 'custom-' for custom models.
- `vendor` (String) CPU vendor visible to the guest when this model is selected. Vendor of 'reported-model' in case of custom models.


<a id="nestedatt--machines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (String) Full name of machine type and version.
- `changes` (String) Notable changes of a version, currently only set for +pveX versions.
- `type` (String) The machine type.
- `version` (String) The machine version.


<a id="nestedatt--migration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `migration`

Read-Only:

- `has_dbus_vmstate` (Boolean) Whether the host supports live-migrating additional VM state via the dbus-vmstate helper.
